If you get at least 35 Marks in any one of the 2 OPPE’S, then you are passed in OPPE.
What is your score? What is the issue and please elaborate it clearly.

posts.name: MEENA
posts.cooked:
Hi, My OPPE score is 25. I remember 1 question was full correct and for one more question, I had few test cases cleared for which I thought I would have cleared the OPPE. I would like to reverify my score again.
For the September 2024 term, I took repeat OPPE only for SC and I have completed all other courses for the Diploma with this term. So it would be helpful if you can help to re-verify my SC OPPE score.

Thanks

posts.name: User
posts.cooked:
Each question carries 25 marks , you need to get 35% to pass OPPE.
For Corrections and any discrepancies in OPPE score, a gform was shared right after OPPE scores are released and the deadline was over.

Now it is not possible to check and update the OPPE scores.
